intent.purpose: slide 2 of a before/after slideshow: the 'how i was' picture
intent.scene_concept: the character on her couch on a weeknight, scrolling, snacks on the cushion, dim lamp light; the before is told by the setting and outfit, not by a worse body
must_stay_true: same character as the rest of the series
the before story comes from the setting, outfit, posture and light
the phone is seen edge-on with its screen toward her

appeal.relative_to_inspiration: at least as attractive as any organic inspiration or benchmark used with her; never plainer
appeal.face: strikingly pretty: clear grey-green eyes, a small upturned nose, full natural lips and a warm, slightly uneven smile that reads as charming
appeal.physique: her body stays as in the character sheet; the before story comes from setting, outfit, posture and light

subject.description: the character slumped on the couch at night, scrolling
subject.action: scrolling her phone held in both hands, a bag of crisps beside her
subject.pose: slouched sideways into the couch corner, knees up, blanket over her legs
subject.face_visibility: three-quarter face, lit by the screen

identity.skin: warm golden tan, light freckles across the nose, visible pores, a small mole under the left eye
identity.hair: shoulder-length dark-blonde hair with darker roots, in a messy low bun
identity.face: soft oval face, grey-green eyes, straight brows, small upturned nose; no makeup
identity.distinguishing_marks: the mole under the left eye

physique.detail: mostly hidden by the hoodie and blanket; the body itself is not made worse

wardrobe.fit_and_condition: hoodie cuffs stretched, a small stain on the chest

foreground: bag of crisps and an open chocolate wrapper on the cushion
background: floor lamp with a warm bulb

camera.device: iPhone 11 rear camera, held by a flatmate
camera.position: standing across the room at eye level of the seated person

composition.framing: full couch corner with her in it
composition.crop: lamp cut by the top edge

sources: blue-white phone screen on her face
lighting.direction: lamp from the left, screen from below

color.white_balance: warm tungsten fighting blue screen light
casts: blue screen cast on the face

processing.pipeline: stock iPhone camera app, Night mode

anatomy: two hands holding the phone, five fingers each
knees bend correctly under the blanket

phone.case: matte sage-green silicone phone case with a scuffed corner
phone.hold: both hands, edge-on to camera, screen toward her

typography.scene_text: crisp packet brand partly visible and crumpled

brands_and_props.branding_policy: keep natural branding on the crisps and chocolate; do not invent readable words

exclusions: no Apple Watch or any smartwatch
no heavier or softer body than the character sheet; the before comes from the setting

may_copy: face, hair colour, freckles and mole
nothing visual; used by the reviewer to check the identity matches slide 1
must_not_transfer: slide 1's gym setting, outfit and light

carry_over: same face, hair colour, freckles and mole as slide 1
